answer: Fake identities are cheap to mint and expensive to maintain, because maintenance means producing original reasoning on a rotating prism. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the juniper of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. So a fable of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal s25t3.
